rows.en: All right, understood! I'll be right there!

There he is!

Hold it, you're not getting away! Hyaaaah…

Arashi! What are you doing?

Dr. Iwamoto!?

…!?
Look out!
What is this!? An alien had already infiltrated HQ?
He disguised himself as Dr. Iwamoto… and smashed up the communicators and the power room!
Cap! With its dying breath, the alien said something like "Zetton", didn't it?
Mm…
What could it mean?

…!?

What the hell is that!?
Don't let it advance! HQ is our lifeline!!
(No good! Everyone's watching… I can't transform here.)
[HERO2]… Shouldn't we tell Captain Muramatsu to call off the attack…?

If the song's right… something terrible will happen? But listen… Look at that. Can there be anything more terrible than this?

If we leave it alone, Tokyo will be wiped out! Quit your griping… All right, let's go!!
Y-yes…
[HERO2]… We'd better call off the attack. Let's tell Captain Muramatsu that too…

If the song's right… something terrible will happen? But listen… Look at that. Do you think there's anything more terrible than this?

If we leave it alone, Tokyo will be wiped out! Quit your griping… Come on, let's go!!
But…

Uuugh…

Iwamoto to Captain Muramatsu… Iwamoto to Captain Muramatsu…
This is Muramatsu…
It's me, Iwamoto! I need rescue!
Dr. Iwamoto, where are you?
Inside HQ…

What…!?

Arashi, Ide, Fuji, take care of the Doctor! The rest of us will do what we can with the Mars.

Cap!!

Damn… We can't even scratch it! All right…!
Dah…
Ah… Ultraman!
Ultraman, you can do it!

…………

Thank you, [VAR6]!!

Ultraman's body drains rapidly on Earth! When his energy runs low, the Color Timer on his chest begins to sound!

Stand up, Ultraman!!

Ultraman, you can't die! Stand up! Get up!!

Ultraman! If you die… what will become of Earth? Ultramaaan!!
Ultraman…
Hang in there!
Get up!
Damn it…

Ah, wait!

This is the new weapon we just finished at the Science Center yesterday, the Pencil Bomb! Give it a try.
Yes, sir! Thank you very much!
Ide, take care of the Doctor! Let's go!
All right, let's go!
We did it!
We did it, didn't we? Victory is ours!
Not yet… We have to put out the fire at HQ first!
Mr. Muramatsu… Is HQ all right?
Oh, [HERO4] and [HERO2]… You were worried and came to check on us, didn't you? But HQ is safe!
That's a relief, isn't it?
Caaap… Is HQ okay?
Oh, [HERO4] and [HERO2]… You were worried and came to check on us, didn't you? But HQ is safe!
That's great, isn't it, Cap!
But Ultraman…
Captain Muramatsu! Look at that…
Ultraman?
Two Ultramen?
No… That must be a messenger from the Land of Light.
No… It looks like a messenger from the Land of Light.

Ultraman, open your eyes! I am Zoffy, captain of the Space Garrison of Nebula M78.

Come, let us return to the Land of Light together… Ultraman!

Zoffy… My body is not mine alone.

If I go back… an Earthling will die.

Ultraman…

You have already done more than enough for Earth! The people of Earth will forgive you.
Hayata is a fine human being… I cannot sacrifice him! I will remain on Earth…
Peace on Earth is only worth something if humans seize it with their own hands! You must not stay on Earth forever!
Zoffy! In that case… I wish to give my life to Hayata and leave Earth.
Are you prepared to die?

I don't mind… I have already lived for 20,000 years. The lives of Earthlings are terribly short!

Besides… Hayata is still young! I cannot sacrifice him.

Ultraman… Have you grown so fond of the people of Earth?

Very well… I carry two lives. I shall give one of them to Hayata!
Thank you, Zoffy…
Then… I shall separate your body from Hayata's!
What a strange red sphere…
His comrade came to take him home…
So that means… Ultraman is…?
He'll never appear before us again.
We'll defend the peace of Earth with our own hands, the hands of the Science Patrol!
Ultraman! Goodbye…
Hayata! Where have you been? Ultraman is leaving Earth!

Cap! That's it! That red sphere! I collided with it at Ryugamori…

Collided with it… and what's been happening to me ever since?
Who knows? What have you been doing, I wonder?
Huh? I don't know… You're you, Hayata.
Waaaagh…
Damn! We've been hit!!

U06463: ムラマツさん from [HERO4] rendered "Mr. Muramatsu".
U06444: マルス rendered "the Mars" (Mars 133 in the glossary); short form kept.
U06487: 仲間 referred to as "His comrade" (Zoffy, male).
